expected_mechanism: MPC solver fails to converge, immediate LQR takeover; LQR attempts recovery from small tracking error.
Solver failure at low speed on straight; LQR starts with small error, recovery likely if within linear range.
Stale output during curve exit; LQR must correct accumulated error, rate limits may hinder rapid recovery.
Two-tick output delay; LQR receives stale command at switch, initial recovery attempt based on outdated steering intent.
Six-tick delay at moderate speed entering curve; LQR switch occurs with delayed state information, likely insufficient margin for recovery.
Constant bias added to MPC output; LQR takeover occurs with bias present, offset error may prevent lane recovery.
Bias on curve exit at low speed; LQR must overcome bias while dealing with decreasing curvature, recovery margin uncertain.
Drift at low speed entering curve; error growth may be slow enough for LQR to recover if switch occurs early in drift trajectory.
